run_generate_gallery: run generate_gallery.py to render every Menagerie model's thumbnail and update the README gallery
create_thumbnail_rendering: create transparent PNG thumbnails for MuJoCo Menagerie robot models using segmentation-based alpha masking
build_readme_gallery_table: build a categorized markdown table of robot models with previews, names, DoFs, and licenses in README.md
test_auto_camera_placement: test auto_camera function that frames a model's AABB tightly from a per-type viewing direction
review_model_type_enum: review the ModelType enum that classifies robots into categories like ARM, QUADRUPED, HUMANOID, and DRONE
